item.title: Two People Shot at Apartments on Indy’s West Side
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS — Two people were shot Friday afternoon on the west side of Indianapolis, according to the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department. Police were called over to the Riverchase Apartments on River Walk Drive. That’s near Crawfordsville and North Girls School roads. Both people shot are awake and breathing.
